decls.name: CMModelDiscriminantClassNumberBounds

paper_span.quote: The class-number estimate in Proposition 3.7 therefore gives

decls.rationale: Property (P5), class-number clause: applying Proposition 3.7 to \(K_j\) with \(\mathrm{rd}(K_j) \le 2\,\mathrm{rd}(F)\) gives \(h(K_j) \le H_\ell^{f_j}\) with \(H_\ell = (2\,\mathrm{rd}(F))^{2C_{\mathrm{class}}}\), so \(\log H_\ell = O(\ell\log\ell)\).
